source: Own measurement, 2026-11-16, on the fixed hidden set (tests/hidden/episodes.json: draw 6, 18 episodes, 2 per unit, selected after the built-in placement rule: a cooktop and an oven keep yaw 0) with this build's grader and renderer: the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, token truth) through the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505) on apollo-pc-2's Docker, five ale validate runs of the tree of commit 545b41c with the temporary local-asset build of the task image on top (spec_hash a7b468a6), 18 episodes each: validate-3c32c9a4, validate-87a1f669, validate-b5f616c7, validate-9c9fcd5c and validate-8547fd09, mean_request_credit 1.0 in each (the oracle's verification.json), so the mean over 90 episodes is 1.0. Every run: 18 of 18 episodes scored, no aborts, no simulation faults, untouched 0.0, probe pairs 601 of 602 differing over the five runs (115/115, 120/121, 112/112, 119/119, 135/135). After the budget fix of 2026-11-23 (the budget is the controller's own time, the controller is stopped between requests, the numerics are pinned; selection amendment 4 keeps the same 18 episodes, the reference repeating its kept runs step for step): ale validate of commit 284748cd (these files but for this text) with the pinned engine (vendor/ale bfb7505) on an AMD Zen 5 host, validate-1dd4e2a6: untouched 0.0, the reference 1.0, mean_request_credit 1.0 over the 18 episodes, no aborts, no simulation faults, probe pairs 120 of 121 differing, numerics_ok 1; the same 18 episodes graded outside the engine on an AMD Zen 3 host gave the same steps and request outcomes in every episode.
note: Measured, not drawn. The set holds only episodes on which the reference scored 1.0 in process and in three runs over the real wire when it was selected (tests/hidden/episode_selection.json); over the wire the reference can still lose a request now and then (the draw-4 anchor runs lost half of one oven request in one run of five). full_at 0.98: one request of the 54 lost (metric 0.98148, ratio 0.98148) still gives the reference reward 1.0; two lost (0.96296) give 0.983.
